newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Floods displace hundreds of Somali families.
newsitem.headline: Floods displace hundreds of Somali families.

text.p: Heavy rains along the Indian Ocean coast of Somalia have displaced hundreds of families and done great damage to property, residents said on Saturday.

One of the worst hit areas is around the town of Gioher, 80 km (50 miles) north of the capital in the Shebele valley, where 400 families have fled two villages to seek shelter in Gioher, radio operator Mohamed Shire said by radio.
Residents of Dabagalo village much further north have also abandoned their houses for higher ground, chief elder Mohamed Agaite said by radio from the nearby town of Harardera.
The losses include houses, livestock, farmland and food stocks but no casualties have been reported.
